Name: Adadah
ModernLocation: Unknown; in the Negev of Judah
Description: Adadah was a town in Judah's Negev allotment, named in the town list of Joshua 15. No further story is attached to it in Scripture, and its exact site is unidentified.
BiblicalSignificance: Its inclusion in the allotment list marks it as one of the towns assigned to Judah.
